facts: The DSR product is instantaneous direct plus diffuse surface shortwave irradiance in W/m2, not an hourly energy total.
GOES17 DSR reached provisional quality inJune2019. Public noaa-goes16/17 S3 DSR archives beginDecember5 2019.
GOES18 became operationalGOES-WestJanuary4 2023 18UTC; useGOES17 before then.
AtApril17 2024 16:40UTC EnterpriseAlgorithm changedDSR fromhourly0.25degreeCONUS to10minute2kmfull disk; usefixed0.25degreegeographicfootprint toreduce spatial confounding.
GOES18 DSR full validation maturity fromJanuary4 2025; operational product changes and ancillary errors remain possible.

Filename c timestamp means file creation, not byitself publicdissemination. Require currentS3LastModified also before issue; both agree withinminutes for ordinary samplefiles. Reuploadedhistoricalobjects are excluded conservatively.
Good/degraded valid DSR values are retained; fillvalues and outside0–1500W/m2 rejected; at least90%pixels withinfixedcell mustbevalid.
